column1: # Novation Circuit Mono Station patch parameter schema.
# Extracted verbatim from Novation Components 1.72.5 (app.asar, main-*.js, array 'kD').
# patchIndex/overlayIndex are byte positions in the 126-byte unpacked patch payload /
# the pack-overlay map. dt: DT_U=0..127, DT_U8=0..255, DT_S=signed(center 64), DT_S8=signed(center 128),
# DT_B=boolean at bit 'rs', DT_M=menu masked by 'min'. See docs/sysex-spec.md.
